description: Filter last night’s scores across every scoreable US-listed company by score band, sector, or a list of tickers to compare side by side. Returns compact rows, highest score first, each with how many points the composite moved in about a week. The feed excludes symbols whose fundamental score is missing or built on under 40% of the fundamental weight — closed-end funds, preferred lines and pre-merger shells.

maxScore.description: Only symbols scoring at or below this (0-100)

minScore.description: Only symbols scoring at or above this (0-100)

symbols.description: Only these tickers (max 50); any not in the feed come back under `missing`

name: screen_stocks
title: Screen or compare stocks
